items.description: Here's a look at what each NFL team is wearing in Week 3, led by the new NFL Rivalries look from the Indianapolis Colts.

items.headline: Cowboys look to corral Ravens' Lamar Jackson in Rio as questions about field conditions persist
items.description: Kenny Clark is headed back to Brazil, where his Dallas Cowboys face Baltimore two years after the defensive tackle played for the Green Bay Packers on a “mushy” field.

items.headline: Baltimore Ravens feel prepared for Rio 'business trip'
items.description: This is the Ravens' first game in Brazil, but coach Jesse Minter was there last season.

items.headline: Lamar Jackson focused on football ahead of Rio game
items.description: Jamison Hensley reports that Lamar Jackson is treating the Ravens' trip to Brazil as purely business.

items.headline: Lamar Jackson, Ravens not focusing on field conditions in Rio
items.description: A day before the Ravens travel to Brazil to play the Cowboys, quarterback Lamar Jackson said he isn't focusing on the condition of the field at Maracanã Stadium.

items.headline: Evaluating surprise early-season trends for 32 NFL teams
items.description: T.J. Watt is dominant again? The Packers can't run the ball? Drew Lock is fourth in QBR? Let's figure out which early stats and trends have staying power and which are a mirage.
